title: Killer Cases
description:
S03 E02 — The Mennonite Murder
A camper gathering firewood in Arizona's scenic Sunset Crater National Park is shocked to discover the body of a young woman in a traditional long dress; her Mennonite family and friends are stunned.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S03 E03 — The Exchange Student Murder
An exchange student finds a career and a love match in the idyllic Missouri university town of Columbia; it's a shock to her friends and family when she disappears, leaving both her child and cellphone behind.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S03 E01 — The Arson Murders
Firefighters make a desperate effort to save a family from a fire, but rescuers arrive too late; police declares the fire was no accident and begins an arson investigation, which includes another unexplained fire that killed a beloved elderly couple.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S02 E04 — The Pizza Delivery Murder
A single mom and pizza delivery driver was murdered on a late-night run for Dominos, and police arrested her former boyfriend.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S03 E12 — Murder at Ohio State
When Ohio State senior Reagan Tokes fails to respond to messages from her parents, they fear the worst; a caller reports the discovery of a female body in the local park; detectives race to solve the crime.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S03 E05 — Murder at the Beauty Salon
When a hairstylist fails to pick up her children for a planned celebration, she is reported missing by her ex-husband; investigators discover a bloody scene at the salon, but the hairstylist and her SUV are gone.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S02 E08 — The Murder of Mollie Tibbetts
Police have few clues in the disappearance of University of Iowa student Mollie Tibbetts until a local resident shares his garage surveillance camera footage; police later arrest Cristhian Bahena Rivera, who is living in the country illegally.

description:

title: Murder at the Motel
description:
S01 E07 — A Night Terror

title: Murder in the 21st
description:
S01 E06 — In Plain Sight
A quadruple homicide goes unsolved for over a decade; while one investigation goes cold, another heats up as the search for a missing couple holds the key to unravelling the secrets of a serial killer.

title: Murder in the 21st
description:
S01 E02 — Vigilante Justice
When a 19-year-old struggling to make it on her own goes missing, her family kicks into high gear to find her; as precious time runs out and the hope of bringing her home alive grows dim, two unlikely people team up to confront a dangerous predator.

title: Murder in the 21st
description:
S01 E05 — The Girl Next Door
The community of Macon, Ga., is gripped in a wave of terror when a beautiful law student disappears from her apartment complex; the shocking discovery of a body leads investigators uncomfortably close to home.

title: Murder in the 21st
description:
S01 E07 — Catfish Killer
A jilted lover takes to the internet to stalk her ex and threaten his girlfriend; when she finally follows through on her violent threats, detectives find themselves entangled in a deadly web of deception.

title: Murder in the 21st
description:
S01 E03 — All in the Family
The peaceful town of Mountain City, Tenn., is rocked when a beloved young couple are found brutally murdered in their home; as police search for their killer, they uncover a family enmeshed in sinister secrets and lies.
